utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, The Thursday Murder Club — I’ve got it this time. Thanks for keeping me on track!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Glad to hear it—how’s the discussion going so far?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Pretty lively so far—lots of theories, and I’m mostly trying to keep up without losing the title again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the extra chairs and tea covered, and I can bring cookies and fruit too. That should have book club set for snacks.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, nice — that sounds perfect. I’m still a little fuzzy on the details, but I’ll try to be there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep you posted on the details, and just come as you are. We’ll save you a seat and some tea.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — was it "The Night Circus"?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not quite — we were still deciding, and I’ve got a few other good options too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—send me the options and I’ll vote for one.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes please—send over a few cozy options and I’ll happily vote. I’m excited to see what we pick!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send over a few cozy picks and double-check the title too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks, Sam — I appreciate that! I’m looking forward to the options.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm whether it’s actually at my place this Thursday evening? I’d rather not assume until it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t think we’ve set your place yet — I was still thinking 7:00 PM at my place this Thursday. If you want, I can send a quick update to everyone so it’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, got it — so it’s not at my place yet, and you’re saying 7:00 PM at yours this Thursday? Yes, please send the update so everyone’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly Mara, June, and old Mr. Vale have been the regulars lately—same steady trio as before.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Got it—keeping the regular trio makes things easy. So what’s the plan for next Thursday at 7, and are we still reading The Secret Garden?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, next Thursday at 7 is still on, and we’re sticking with The Secret Garden. I’ll spread the word if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking on that mystery title, but I’ll send it over as soon as I find out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works for me — send it when you can, and I’ll keep the book club list moving in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know as soon as I get the title.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh—right, the book club. I’m sorry, I’m a bit distracted today; could you remind me which one we picked?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure either—let me check the title and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I appreciate it — I’ll keep an eye out for your message.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check my calendar and send a couple of times after 3:30 that won’t conflict with school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye — that works for me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll send you a couple of options soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll remind everyone tomorrow and keep the group updated.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll put together the shortlist and main talking points tonight so we’re ready to vote tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll send the reminder tomorrow and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you double-check the title for me? I want to make sure I’ve got it right for book club.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure — it’s "The Night Circus."

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — I’ve got it now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday at 7 at your place still works for me, and I can bring a drink. Just let me know if anything specific would help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works for me too—thanks, Pia. Just bring whatever drink you like, and I’ll have the book club stuff ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — I’ll bring a drink and plan for Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’d like to hear who’s been coming lately.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to come, but I’d still like the time and place so I can plan my ride. If you need me to bring anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia — I’ll check the time and place and let you know. If there’s anything to bring, I’ll tell you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can check what the club picked next and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just confirm whether it’s Thursday at my place, and what time if it is.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll check that and let you know — if it’s Thursday at your place, I’ll include the time too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly Mara, June, and old Mr. Vale have been showing up regularly lately. A few others drift in and out, but that little trio’s been the steady core.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s a lovely core group — I’m glad Mara, June, and Mr. Vale keep things steady. I’ll make sure the rest of the invite still feels warm and welcoming for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’ll mean a lot to them — they like feeling welcomed, even when the crowd shifts a bit.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the details, so I can confirm the day, time, and library location once I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — send the day, time, and library location when you have them, and I’ll remind everyone once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll confirm the day, time, and whether it’s still at the library, then send it over once I know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you double-check the title for me? I want to make sure we’ve got the right book for club.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I’ll check which mystery they picked and tell you as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. Let me know once you confirm the title.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the book club. I think I’m still in, but I need the title again.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: We’re reading "The Secret Garden" this time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—"The Secret Garden." Thanks, I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check my calendar and send over a couple of times that work after 3:30 or in the early evening.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — send me a couple options and I’ll pick the best fit for everyone. If you want, I can also keep the snack list simple.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that’d help — simple snacks are great. I’ll send a couple of time options after 3:30 that won’t conflict with school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great—send them over and I’ll vote. I’m excited to see what cozy read we pick next!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara — I’ll send the options over when I can. I’m a little scattered today, but I’m still hoping to make book club tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Uli — just send them when you can, and I hope you make it tonight too!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great—next Thursday at 7 works for me, and I’m happy to bring the simple agenda. What time should I arrive at your place?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 7 works great—come by around 6:45 if that’s easy. I’ll double-check the book title too, just to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 6:45 is perfect—thank you. I’ll keep it simple and look for your book title update.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—give me the highlights!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure—quick version: we’re trying to pick a time that works around school pickup, and Faye said she’ll send a couple options soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great—thanks! I’ll keep an eye out for Faye’s options.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds like a great plan, Opal—let’s start with the book everyone finished and list the strongest discussion points.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll put together a quick list of the main themes and reactions, then we can choose a spot for book club.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Opal—thank you. Once you’ve got that list, I can help us pick the best discussion spot and keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I’m still a little mixed up, but I think we’re on that mystery novel. Was it The Thursday Murder Club again?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Maybe—I'm not sure, but send me the title when you know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’ll ask Mara and send you the title once I’ve got it straight.

injected.text: Update: the book club has been moved from Tuesday at the library to Thursday at the cafe.
